name: Web Recon - View Source
description:
A web portal has been deployed for internal operations, but something appears to have been accidentally exposed to anyone who knows where to look.

Your first task is to perform basic web reconnaissance and inspect what the browser normally hides from the page.

🎯 Mission

Visit:

[CLickTHisLink](Flag1.cgcybercom.online)

Submit only the required answer using the flag format: pcgCTF{answer}

hints.content: Inspect the page source and identify the hidden flag.
Sometimes the browser shows you only what the developer intended you to see.
